decisions.reason: Changing help-label language to Danish does not alter the mechanism or behavior of the editable text fields.
The language of persistent help labels does not change whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The source changes label language only and does not modify the required template theme colors.
The Danish help-label decision is unrelated to graphic bullet appearance or level-specific bullet design.
Changing field help labels to Danish does not necessarily change the required style-set coverage or its listed style additions.
The label-language change does not affect legacy-to-new template copy-paste behavior.
The source decision does not alter Tab-key behavior or list hierarchy requirements.
The language used for field help labels has no necessary effect on paragraph or manual line-break behavior.
The source decision does not change table layout or page-boundary stability.
The label-language change does not modify the assessment steps, outputs, coverage, or time budget.
